page.title: App Access
page.blurb: Verify a third-party local App contract against the real Runtime link: session and identity posture, app-private storage, Realm data, AI consumption, Agent conversation, and boundary rejections. Every probe runs the real path; nothing is simulated.
page.signedOut: Sign in to Nimi from the account menu to run App Access probes.
page.sessionLost: The Nimi session was lost. Probe evidence from the previous session has been cleared.
page.noAgentReferences: No active Agent under the current account. Create and activate one in Nimi Desktop, then re-run Active Agent references.

sessionStates.processReplaced: App process was replaced — restart the App

sessionBar.title: Session & Identity
sessionBar.blurb: Independent facts, each queried on its own — none is derived from another.

storage.title: App Storage (Base)
storage.blurb: App-private JSON storage, isolated per App.

realm.title: Realm Data
realm.blurb: Declared Realm data access: list and create WorldCores.

aiConsumption.title: AI Consumption
aiConsumption.blurb: Portable AIConfig, Local text generation, and grantless Cloud posture.

agentConversation.title: Agent Conversation
agentConversation.blurb: Active Agent references, typed conversation, and turn interrupt — in dependency order.

boundary.title: Boundary Probes
boundary.blurb: Forbidden authority fields and storage escapes must be rejected.

storageIsolation.title: Storage isolation
storageIsolation.proves: App-private JSON write, read-back, and removal stay consistent inside the App storage boundary.
storageIsolation.running: Writing, reading back, and removing an App-private document…

worldList.title: WorldCore listing
worldList.proves: The App can list local Realm WorldCores through its declared Realm data access.

worldCreate.title: WorldCore create & read-back
worldCreate.proves: A WorldCore created through the App Realm owner reads back with matching identity and content hash.
worldCreate.running: Creating a WorldCore and verifying the read-back…

portableAiConfig.title: Portable AIConfig
portableAiConfig.proves: A portable App AIConfig whole-overwrite with a Local route persists and reads back without custody fields.

localText.title: Local text generation
localText.proves: The committed Local route serves a unary text generation through the real Runtime path.
localText.running: Generating text through the committed Local route…
localText.gateGuidance: Run Portable AIConfig first so a Local route is committed.

cloudPosture.title: Cloud authorization posture
cloudPosture.proves: A grantless Cloud intent persists, and its execution must demand a Nimi-owned authorization selection.
cloudPosture.running: Saving a grantless Cloud intent and proving selection-required…
cloudPosture.gateGuidance: Paste catalog-derived values for all five fields — Tester has no provider/model defaults by design. Find them in the Runtime model catalog.

agentReferences.title: Active Agent references
agentReferences.proves: The App can list the current account’s active Agent references for typed conversation.

agentConversation.title: Agent conversation
agentConversation.proves: A typed Agent conversation opens, streams, and completes with a committed assistant reply.
agentConversation.gateGuidance: Select an active Agent reference first.

agentInterrupt.title: Agent turn interrupt
agentInterrupt.proves: An accepted Agent turn can be explicitly interrupted and ends in the interrupted terminal state.
agentInterrupt.running: Opening a typed Agent conversation to interrupt…
agentInterrupt.gateGuidance: Select an active Agent reference first.

authorityInjection.title: Authority injection rejected
authorityInjection.proves: Owner and custody fields injected into a portable AIConfig are rejected before leaving the App.
authorityInjection.running: Injecting forbidden owner and custody fields…

storageBoundary.title: Storage boundary rejected
storageBoundary.proves: Path escapes and oversized writes against App-private storage are rejected.
storageBoundary.running: Attempting a path escape and an oversized write…

failures.storageRoundtripMismatch: Stored data did not match what was written.
failures.storageRemoveFailed: The stored document could not be removed.
failures.unexpectedSuccess: The Runtime accepted an operation that must be rejected — the boundary is broken.
failures.unexpectedRejection: The operation was rejected for a different reason than expected.
failures.aiConfigReadbackInvalid: The saved AI configuration did not read back as a clean portable Local route.
failures.cloudReadbackInvalid: The saved Cloud intent did not read back as a grantless portable intent.
failures.cloudIntentFieldInvalid: A Cloud intent field is empty, has surrounding whitespace, or is too long.
failures.worldCoreListReadMismatch: The created WorldCore did not read back with matching identity and content hash.
failures.operationFailed: The probe could not be completed. See technical details.
